title: SELECT and Filtering
description: Retrieve exactly the data you need using SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, and other essential clauses. Master filtering, sorting, and limiting results.
whatYouLearn: How to write a SELECT statement to retrieve columns from a table
How to filter rows using the WHERE clause with comparison and logical operators
How to sort results with ORDER BY and control ascending/descending order
How to remove duplicates with DISTINCT and limit results with TOP or OFFSET-FETCH
How to combine result sets with UNION, INTERSECT, and EXCEPT
